name: @iflow-mcp/modesty_fluent-mcp

flag.description: SDK flag to execute: -v/--version (SDK version), -h/--help (SDK help)

command.description: Specific command to get help for (only used with -h/--help flag)

tools.name: init_fluent_app
tools.description: Initialize a new ServiceNow custom application or convert a legacy ServiceNow application from an instance or directory within the current directory. Uses MCP elicitation to gather required parameters based on your intent.

intent.description: Specify your intent: "conversion" to convert an existing scoped app to Fluent, or "creation" to create a new scoped app. If not provided, you will be prompted to choose.

from.description: For conversion: sys_id of the sys_app record or local file path to convert from

appName.description: For creation: The name of the application.

packageName.description: For creation: The NPM package name for the application, usually it's the snake-case of appName in lowercase with company prefix.

scopeName.description: For creation: The scope name for the application in x_<scope_name> format. Must start with 'x_' prefix. No spaces allowed, no greater than 18 characters.

template.description: For creation only (required): Template to use for the project. Choices: "base", "javascript.react", "typescript.basic", "typescript.react", "javascript.basic". Not needed for conversion.

auth.description: Credential alias to use for authentication with instance (auto-injected from session if not provided)

workingDirectory.description: The directory where the Fluent (ServiceNow SDK) application will be created. Must be an empty local directory with no package.json or now.config.json files.

tools.name: build_fluent_app
tools.description: Build the Fluent (ServiceNow SDK) application located in the current working directory.

tools.name: deploy_fluent_app
tools.description: Deploy the Fluent (ServiceNow SDK) application to a ServiceNow instance

auth.description: Credential alias to use for authentication with instance (auto-injected from session if not provided)

tools.name: fluent_transform
tools.description: Download and convert XML records from instance or from a local path into Fluent source code

from.description: Path to local XML file(s)/directory to transform

directory.description: Path to "package.json", default to current working directory

auth.description: Credential alias to use for authentication with instance (auto-injected from session if not provided)

preview.description: Preview fluent output and any transform errors without saving, default false

tools.name: download_fluent_dependencies
tools.description: Download configured dependencies in now.config.json and TypeScript type definitions for use in the application

auth.description: Credential alias to use for authentication with instance (auto-injected from session if not provided)

tools.name: download_fluent_app
tools.description: Download application metadata from instance, including metadata that not exist in local but deployed to instance

source.description: Path to the directory that contains package.json configuration

incremental.description: Download application metadata from the instance in incremental mode

tools.name: clean_fluent_app
tools.description: Clean up output directory of a Fluent (ServiceNow SDK) application

source.description: Path to the directory that contains package.json configuration

tools.name: pack_fluent_app
tools.description: Zip built Fluent (ServiceNow SDK) application into installable artifact

source.description: Path to the directory that contains package.json configuration

tools.name: get-api-spec
tools.description: Fetches the Fluent API specification for a given ServiceNow metadata type. Call without arguments to list all available metadata types.

metadataType.description: ServiceNow metadata type (e.g., business-rule, script-include). Omit to list all available types.

tools.name: get-snippet
tools.description: Fetches the Fluent code snippet for a given ServiceNow metadata type

id.description: Optional identifier for specific resource (only for snippets)

tools.name: get-instruct
tools.description: Retrieves instructions of Fluent API usage for a given ServiceNow metadata type

id.description: Optional identifier for specific resource (only for snippets)

tools.name: check_auth_status
tools.description: Check current ServiceNow authentication status. Returns the result of auto-auth validation including status, profile alias, instance host, and any required action.
